topic: Fixing unique identifiers and data infrastructure
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on two technical issues: fixing unique identifiers (unics) and improving the real-time data infrastructure. Initially, it was determined that promising a real-time fix for the next day is not feasible due to current limitations.

A quick workaround fix for the unics issue is estimated to take 2–4 hours of focused work. However, a preferred long-term solution involves refactoring the real-time data pipeline to eliminate the need for multiple `UNION ALL` statements pulling from separate data sources, which would require up to a week.

It was agreed that the quick fix could be implemented if dedicated time is allocated.
decisions: A short-term workaround fix for unique identifiers will be implemented.
The long-term goal of refactoring the real-time data pipeline remains, but requires significant time.
action_items: Allocate dedicated time to implement the quick fix for unics.
